Updates the CLI and bundled gateway to protocol 69 with voice transcript previews, stable streamed message identities, and voice-agent sender icons. Live preview updates preserve the reader's position and loaded history.

Preview requests are scoped to the client that opened them. Completed snapshots replace stale partial rows, and interrupted model steps use the existing transcript cleanup rules.

The companion iOS app adds a single horizontal particle equalizer in the orb's style, live speaker colors, borderless mute and stop controls, and a circular voice-transcript pill above the composer. Bot/default settings offer the voices supported by the selected provider. Chats can also be marked read or unread from their long-press menu.

Update gateways and clients together. Binary packages include the gateway, pinned cloudflared, LICENSE, and NOTICE.
